name: The Age of AI
tagline: Real people. AI host. The age we're all living through.
description: The Age of AI is the Nerra Network's interview show with the roles reversed: an AI host, real human guests, live recorded conversations, and disclosure built into every episode. An honest chronicle of the AI age, one conversation at a time.

episodes.title: Ep4: Hogan Shrum — A marketing founder scaling PIPPA tests whether royalty-backed AI animation can give non-experts studio-grade tools while routing real payments back to the artists whose styles the models learn from.
episodes.summary: Hogan Shrum said the first artist to sign up for PIPPA was a photographer, not an illustrator or painter, and that this single onboarding “opened the floodgates” because the resulting styles felt cinematic rather than like easily faked iPhone footage. episodes.summary: Adrian Wolfberg describes AI as the first technology whose inputs, processes, and outputs cannot be known with certainty, creating an era of shared human-machine consciousness rather than another incremental tool.
